title: Marcos administers oath of 10 Cabinet officials
summary: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. administered Friday the oath of office to 10 of his ad interim appointees heading various government agencies.

blocks.text: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. administered Friday the oath of office to 10 of his ad interim appointees heading various government agencies.
In a ceremony at Malacañan Palace, the following Cabinet officials took their oath before the President:

items: Budget Secretary Kim Robert De Leon
Philippine Space Agency Director General Gay Jane Perez

blocks.text: In an interview, Recto explained that the oath-taking signifies that the Cabinet officials have received ad interim appointments from the President and are now set to face the powerful Commission on Appointments (CA).

“Itong oath-taking ngayon ay ibig sabihin lahat kami dito ngayon, ad interim appointments ng Pangulo. Dadaan kaming lahat sa Commission on Appointments. Nakapag-submit na tayo sa Commission on Appointments,” Recto said.

(This oath-taking today means that all of us here have received ad interim appointments from the President. We will all go through the Commission on Appointments. We have already submitted our appointments to the Commission on Appointments.)
The CA is mandated to approve or disapprove appointments made by the President of the Philippines, the confirmation of which is required under the 1987 Constitution.

The commission’s function “forms part of the very delicate mechanism of checks and balances established by the Constitution to ensure that the coordinate departments of the government will function in a way that will be most conducive to the public welfare,” based on its website. — RSJ, GMA News
